title: Token Communication-Assisted Collaborative Embodied Artificial Intelligence: Concepts, Framework, and Opportunities
abstract: arXiv:2610.01826v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collaborative embodied artificial intelligence (CEAI) enables multiple physical agents to perceive, reason, and act cooperatively in dynamic environments. Effective communication is essential for CEAI, yet CEAI agents must exchange not only large multimodal observations but also task-relevant insights, intents, and interactive information over long horizons. This article investigates token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for CEAI, in which tokens serve jointly as compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models (GFMs). We first discuss how TokCom supports insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents. We then propose a TokCom-assisted CEAI framework driven by a task-adaptive communication protocol. translated_title: 令牌通信辅助的协作具身人工智能：概念、框架与机遇
translated_abstract: 协作具身人工智能（CEAI）使多个物理智能体能够在动态环境中协同感知、推理和行动。有效的通信对CEAI至关重要，然而CEAI智能体不仅需要交换大规模的多模态观测数据，还需要在长时间跨度上交换与任务相关的洞察、意图和交互信息。本文研究了令牌通信（TokCom）作为CEAI的原生智能接口，其中令牌同时充当通信的紧凑语义载体和生成式基础模型（GFM）的基本推理单元。我们首先讨论了TokCom如何支持具身智能体之间的洞察共享、意图对齐和交互控制。随后，我们提出了一个由任务自适应通信协议驱动的TokCom辅助CEAI框架。该协议由紧凑的码本、语法规则和上下文示例组成，用于指导基于GFM的收发器……
tldr: 本文提出将令牌通信（TokCom）作为协作具身人工智能的原生智能接口，并构建了一个由任务自适应通信协议驱动的CEAI框架，使令牌同时充当通信的紧凑语义载体和生成式基础模型的基本推理单元，从而支持具身智能体间的洞察共享、意图对齐与交互控制。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes token communication (TokCom) as a native intelligence interface for collaborative embodied AI, presenting a task-adaptive communication protocol-driven framework in which tokens serve as both compact semantic carriers for communication and fundamental inference units for generative foundation models, enabling insight sharing, intent alignment, and interactive control among embodied agents.
